item.title: Mastering Prompt Architecture: Building 7 Advanced Prompt Engineering Frameworks
item.description:
Mastering Prompt Architecture: Building 7 Advanced Prompt Engineering Frameworks

Prompt engineering has evolved far beyond basic instruction writing. When dealing with complex tasks—such as maintaining strict identity preservation during photo enhancement, generating multi-step creative workflows, or ensuring factual accuracy in long-form generation—single-shot prompts often fall short.

To achieve consistent, high-precision results from Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt architects rely on structured meta-frameworks. Below, we break down seven advanced prompt engineering methodologies, examining how each technique operates and when to deploy it for maximum efficacy.

item.title: Mastering Prompt Engineering: A Complete Guide to Slash Commands & Super Prompts
item.description:
Prompt engineering has evolved from simple text inputs into structured, command-driven workflows. By utilizing slash commands and system-level instructions, you can transform standard AI models into highly specialized tools for document processing, content creation, image restoration, and technical problem-solving.

This guide breaks down every prompt configuration covered in our workflow, showing you how to turn raw ideas into executable, highly efficient AI operations.

1. The Super Prompt Framework System

The foundation of command-driven AI interaction relies on a master framework. By feeding the AI a reference logic sheet at the start of a session, you enable short slash commands to trigger complex output styles, reasoning depth, and formatting guardrails instantly.

item.title: Mastering the Mind and Breath: From Prompt Engineering to Tibetan Energy Purification
item.description:
Part 1: Meta-Prompt Engineering for Multimodal Research

Designing an effective prompt requires clear structure: defining roles, specifying context, and setting strict output formats. To test this framework, we constructed a comprehensive research prompt on physical and contemplative mastery—focusing on walking, breathing, and meditation—complete with requests for visual aids, infographics, audio concepts, and step-by-step guides.

Prompt: Research expert techniques for walking, breathing, and meditation.
For each practice, provide:
1. Detailed Step-by-Step Guides (movements, postures, mental focus).
2. Visual Aids (Static images, Infographics, Animated GIF concepts, Short Video & Audio concepts).
3. Emphasis on Accuracy (alignment with physiological and contemplative standards).
4. Expert Perspective (nuances, advanced cues, and framing).

Part 2: The Nine Purification Breaths (རླུང་རོ་དགུ་ཕྲུགས)

In Tibetan subtle-body traditions, the Nine Purification Breaths clear the energetic channels (nadis) of stale wind (prana) and mental obscurations before formal meditation or daily activities.
